description: Hi, our team is called CubeQuest and we are designing a game based on CubeSats. To join our team you must have some basic knowledge about CubeSats, software developing and game designing.
summary: We developed a game called Cube Quest which is based on CubeSats. It addresses the challenge by teaching kids about the unnoticed phenomenon while also being an entertaining and fun game. It is important because many people don't know about the significance of satellites in our everyday life. Cube Quest teaches people of all ages on how to build, maintain and complete a successful satellite mission.
details: Cube Quest is a game based on CubeSats. It teaches people of all ages about the wonder of CubeSats and how to build, maintain and complete a successful CubeSat mission. The intended impact of this game is to impart knowledge about CubeSats so people are more aware of the advanced technology in space. Our team came up with the idea and we then used Claude to code. The videos in the game are self made on Canva and the avatars and Mechanical structure sheet are AI generated.
dataRefs: CubeSat 101: Basic Concepts and Processes for First-Time CubeSat Developers
